# Domain Rules

<!-- Generated by /ai-context. Manual edits are overwritten on re-run. -->

## AS IS — Current state

### Overview

- Restaurant (tenant) owns Categories → Dishes (+ variants, photos, badges).
- Dish has Videos (AI-generated or own upload); one is `active_video`.
- Generation credits: `monthly_balance` + `addon_balance` with a ledger.
- Plans (dish limit, monthly generations, metrics level), add-on packs, platform coupons; billing via Stripe/Cashier.
- Public feed shows only approved content; Mux hosts video.

### Feed eligibility

- `FeedBuilder::eligibleDishes`: dish `visible()`, `active_video_id` not null, active video status slug `aprovado`, category visible.
- Order: category `display_order`, then dish `display_order`.
- Categories shown only if they hold ≥1 eligible dish.
- `DishViewController` returns 403 for suspended restaurants; max 100 views per report, 600 s per report cap.
- Views fold to one `dish_views` row per (dish, session_token, day).

### Video generation request

- `RequestVideoGeneration`: exactly 1 photo (`MAX_PHOTOS=1`), 1–3 variations (owner uses 1), photos must belong to dish.
- Custom prompt: whitespace-normalized, 10–600 chars, or blank → preset prompt.
- Preset must be active with active provider; none → `VideoGenerationUnavailableException`.
- Fails with `InsufficientGenerationBalanceException` when `availableGenerations() < variations`.
- Creates `video_generations` status `fila`, snapshots `provider_id`, dispatches `GenerateDishVideo` after commit.

### Generation balance and ledger

- `availableGenerations() = monthly + addon − reservedGenerations()` (queued requests); `0` without a balance row.
- `DebitGenerationBalance`: one `uso` entry (quantity −1) per generated variation; spends monthly before addon; idempotent by reference.
- `RenewMonthlyBalance` (invoice paid): monthly balance *reset* to `plan.monthly_generations` (no rollover), addon untouched; ledger `renovacao`, reference `stripe_invoice:{id}`.
- Other billing actions: `ApplyPlan`, `CreditAddonPurchase`, `DowngradeToFreePlan`, `GrantFirstSubscriptionBonus` (only first paid invoice with `billing_reason=subscription_create` and `amount_paid>0`).

### Plan dish limit

- `Restaurant::canAddDish()`: true when `plan.dish_limit` is null or dish count < limit.

### Video lifecycle (Mux)

- Statuses seen: `processando`, `aguardando_aprovacao`, `aprovado`, `rejeitado`.
- Own upload re-checked against real duration on `video.asset.ready` (`StartOwnVideoUpload::durationProblem`); too long/short → `rejeitado`, Mux asset dropped.
- `video.asset.errored` → `rejeitado`, asset deleted.
- Provider choice: `config/ai.php` `default` (`AI_VIDEO_PROVIDER`, default `null`); extend by adding class to `providers`.

### Retention (`videos:prune`)

| Case | Rule |
|---|---|
| Variation not picked | deleted 7 days after sibling approved |
| Replaced videos | keep 2 |
| Round never reviewed | removed after 30 days; warning 3 days before (`UnreviewedVideosExpiring`) |

Implemented in `PruneDishVideos` (constants `UNCHOSEN_GRACE_DAYS`, `KEEP_REPLACED`, `UNREVIEWED_DAYS`, `WARN_DAYS_BEFORE`).

### Admin operations

- `Actions/Admin`: `Impersonation`, `SetRestaurantSuspension`, `PurgeRestaurantAccount` (job `PurgeRestaurant`), `RemoveContent`, `RestoreRestaurant`; soft deletes on restaurants/users.

### Appearance and QR

- `config/feed.php`: accent swatches (`#FF6B3D`, `#2E9E6B`, `#3E7BFA`, `#D94F8C`; any hex allowed), default font `DM Serif Display`, 6 fonts.
- QR: `Support/QrCode`, `QrStyle`, `RestaurantQr`, settings stored in `restaurants.qr_settings` via `SaveQrSettings`.
